timecoded_text_to_speech.text: My name is Pooja Raju and I am the medical director for the Interstitial Lung Disease Program,
as well as pulmonary hypertension for the central region for Hacconsec Martin Health.
We treat pulmonary hypertension, pulmonary fibrosis, sarcoid, anything that would affect the lung tissue.
My one and only principle when I treat people is to treat them as I would want to be treated,
or as my family would want to be treated.
Coordinating care for the patients, speaking to their specialists, speaking to their primary care
physician so that everyone is on the same page, making sure that their tests get done in a timely
manner, just making sure that they don't feel like we order something and they're abandoned.
I want to create that environment of knowing that they can count on you.
They can talk to me about their family, their friends, their situations.
It's wonderful for patients to call and say, how are you doing my favorite doctor?
I think it's very important to keep them comfortable and know that they are well cared for.

youtube_description:
Pooja Raju, M.D., is a board certified and fellowship trained physician who has recently joined Hackensack Meridian Medical Group. Her expertise and focus includes Interstitial Lung Disease Evaluation and Management, Pulmonary Hypertension Management, Lung Transplant Patient Evaluation and Management, and Interventional Pulmonary Services including Endobronchial Ultrasound and Biopsy, Bronchial Thermoplasty, Endobronchial Valve placement.
